nodes.name: .python-version
nodes.summary: Pins the Python version expected by the project tooling.

nodes.name: dataset.py
nodes.summary: Provides the Streamlit dataset page and helpers for identifying, validating, and saving pending dataset selections into session state.

nodes.name: source_identity
nodes.summary: Builds a stable identity for a dataset source so duplicate or incompatible selections can be detected.

nodes.name: save_pending_dataset
nodes.summary: Validates the pending dataset and inspection before appending them to Streamlit session state.

nodes.name: gpu_memory.py
nodes.summary: Renders the Streamlit page that displays CUDA memory statistics and exposes cache-release controls.

nodes.name: model.py
nodes.summary: Renders the Streamlit model-selection page and persists model configuration in session state.

nodes.name: monitor.py
nodes.summary: Renders training-run status, queued jobs, progress, logs, and cancel or resume controls in the Streamlit UI.

nodes.name: training_monitor
nodes.summary: Displays queued and active training runs, dispatches waiting work, and provides controls for terminal or recoverable jobs.

nodes.name: ollama.py
nodes.summary: Renders the optional Ollama integration page for local model inference.

nodes.name: review.py
nodes.summary: Renders the review page that presents configured training choices before a run is created.

nodes.name: system.py
nodes.summary: Renders system, dependency, and hardware diagnostics for the local fine-tuning environment.

nodes.name: training.py
nodes.summary: Renders training approach, PEFT method, compute type, presets, and hyperparameter controls in the Streamlit workflow.

nodes.name: approach_changed
nodes.summary: Updates session-state defaults when the selected training approach changes.

nodes.name: apply_preset_defaults
nodes.summary: Copies bounded preset values into editable Streamlit training settings.
